text:
noah: Starting micro-wave rollout: version=v3.4.1 -> routing group 'gen-text'. 5% traffic US-EAST. Change window 21:00-23:59 UTC. Deploy bot kicked off: deploy/6311122334.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollout deploy/6311122334 | image:redwood/gen:v3.4.1 | target=gen-text | canary=5% | plan=5% -> 15% -> 50% | logs: https://deploy.redwood/internal/deploy/6311122334

maria: FYI seeing an unrelated embed error spike in eu-west from earlier warmups. Not sure it will affect this wave but flagging in case cross-traffic hits eu-west.

emma: On it. Do we have the perf + error dashboards handy? pinging @sre-oncall for quick eyes.

sre-oncall: sre-oncall: dashboard snapshot: p95 latency +120ms vs baseline in eu-west, rps steady. embed-error-rate climbed 0.3% -> 1.8% in last 10m. Link: https://dashboards.redwood/xyz
Also ran a quick curl against the canary variant, got 502 on 2/20 attempts.

raj: If embed-error-rate > 1% we should pause and pin to v3.4.0 for the affected route. Propose HOLD at 5% until we confirm.

noah: Agree we can hold. What's the quick pin command if we need to isolate region traffic?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Pin traffic command: `redwoodctl route pin gen-text --version v3.4.0 --scope region=eu-west`
Abort rollout: `redwoodctl rollout abort deploy/6311122334`

emma: I ran `redwoodctl tail deploy/6311122334 --filter embed_error` — logs show malformed tokenization errors in encoder stage on some batches, not all.

maria: Could be tokenizer mismatch with the quantized model variant. Build tag shows `tokenizer: tokenizer-v2`.

noah: Ops decision: HOLD rollout at 5%. Pin eu-west to v3.4.0 and stop further waves. Can someone run the pin and confirm?

raj: I executed the pin for eu-west. Output: `route gen-text pinned to v3.4.0 in eu-west (request-id 0a1b2c)`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout paused by user noah. deploy/6311122334 status=PAUSED at 5% traffic.

emma: I'll open a rollback/regression ticket and capture release notes. Quick notes: v3.4.1 introduces tokenizer-v2 and quantization tweaks; probable tokenizer mismatch.

noah: :thumbsup: Also snapshot evals against canary promptset `regress-embed-001` and compare before we touch anything else.

maria: Running evals now, will share numbers in ~10m. Suggest revert tokenizer to v1 for canary until we root cause.

raj: Follow-up checklist: create a P1 bug, attach logs, model bundle, perf dump, assign to eng-ml.

emma: Done. ticket RED-1234 created: https://issues.redwood/RED-1234 — "embed failures with tokenizer-v2 in v3.4.1 canary". Assigned eng-ml.

noah: Current actions: 1) Pause confirmed 2) eu-west pinned to v3.4.0 3) eng-ml to run evals + investigate tokenizer mismatch 4) ops standing by to resume once validated. Reconvene in 15m. If fixes look good we'll either unpause or roll forward to v3.4.2.

sre-oncall: Monitoring: other regions cleared. eu-west still elevated, continuing to watch.

maria: Eval results (~10m): embedding precision down 3.4% vs baseline, sample failures line up with tokenization errors. Short diff: https://evals.redwood/6311

noah: Decision: keep rollout PAUSED. no go to proceed. If eng-ml provides a hotfix that restores tokenizer-v1 compatibility or a validated tokenizer-v2 patch, we'll open a fresh rollout.

emma: ack — adding follow-up notes to RED-1234. Closing this thread for now; please add any follow-up to the ticket. thanks everyone.
